body.proposed_fix: Owner by card, 2026-11-12 ~4:5x PM PST (ledger note on RIMMANDRAKE_DECIDE_EXPLOSION_MODS_KEEP_ABSORB, OWNER tsn 1794530931586663595): Extra Explosion Effects -> "Absorb the idea into Knockback". The idea, not the mod: Explosive Knockback draws its own bigger, showier blasts with our own flecks and art; nothing of Keshash's code or textures is copied. What the donor does (design/RimMandrake/explosion_mods_characterized_2026-11-12.md, section 1): a Postfix on GenExplosion.DoExplosion adds, for Bomb blasts, extra blast flecks, lingering smoke, dirt or stone debris, soot, a crater and orange sparks; for big blasts (damage over 300 or radius 2 or more) a shockwave and screen quake; for Stun, sparks and ripples. It changes no damage, radius or trigger. Build in ExplosiveKnockback: 1. Our own FleckDefs (defName RM_KnockbackBlast*, at least debris, smoke, soot/scorch, sparks) with our own textures under ExplosiveKnockback/Textures; art goes through the art pipeline and its judge (rimworld-art-evaluation), never donor art. 2. A Harmony hook at the start of an explosion (Explosion.StartExplosion or GenExplosion.DoExplosion) that spawns them; visuals only, no damage, radius or trigger change, and no effect on the throw. 3. Mod Settings: `blastShow` (on by default) and `blastShowBig` for the shockwave/quake branch (on by default), saved and drawn; all off = today's look. 4. Kept mods stay (owner card 2026-11-12 ~5:2x PM PST: Better Explosions and Dynamic Effects Forge "Keep both for good"): our show must sit beside Forge's (Forge sets doVisualEffects=false and draws its own) without doubling; decide the stacking in the design, and prove it on one live blast with both loaded. 5. After it ships, drop Extra Explosion Effects from the test lists (a mod-list change, not a code one). Owner, 2026-11-12 5:36 PM PST: "I can already certify that I like how they look, no test needed." That struck the owed look of the KEPT mods; it does not certify art not yet drawn, so our new flecks go through the art judge. Acceptance test: `python3 src/RimMandrake/ExplosiveKnockback/proof/absorb_blast_show_check.py`, exit 0 with "PASS absorb blast show: 0 failing line(s)" (checks A1-A6: >= 4 own FleckDefs, textures resolve under EK, a StartExplosion/DoExplosion HarmonyPatch, `blastShow` and `blastShowBig` saved and drawn, no donor name). The worker (`infrastructure/stevedesktop/worker.py`) deploys the committed (release) DLL through `deploy_custom_mods.py`, and neither it, `testq.py submit` nor `deploy_custom_mods.py` has a proof-build route (grep for RmProofs/proof_build in all three: none, measured). The job record and its result name the proof build, so ingest never counts it as a release pass. Acceptance test: (1) `python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/testq/testq.py submit --help | grep -q -- --proof-build` exits 0 (watched failing on dd70d7b1d0: exit 1); (2) a worker selftest beside `infrastructure/stevedesktop/selftest_steve_worker.py`, written with the build, that a job with proof_build ExplosiveKnockback runs a build command carrying `-p:RmProofs=true` and an OutputPath outside the clone, deploys its DLL, and leaves `src/RimMandrake/ExplosiveKnockback/Assemblies/` byte-identical; it must go red with the build step removed; (3) live: one queued Explosive Knockback job (`--chains light_things`, proof build) on SteveDesktop reads `container_thrown` PASS or a classified FAIL, never PROOF BUILD REQUIRED.
